name: NICK'S HOUSE
blurb: Nick has finally brought his things home to West Egg. Unpack the car, carry each belonging inside, and make the little house your own.
how: WASD to walk · Mouse to look · Click and drag belongings from the car into the house · ESC for chapters

models.format: glb or gltf; paths resolve from the frontend public root

win.title: A HONEST HOUSE
win.body: All {count} of Nick's belongings are finally inside. The last box settles by the window; the little West Egg house begins to feel like a home, while across the bay the lights of Gatsby's party come alive.
win.quote: I am one of the few honest people that I have ever known.
win.cite: F. Scott Fitzgerald, The Great Gatsby

lose.title: A HOUSE STILL WAITING
lose.body: Nick's belongings remain scattered between the car and the open doorway. There is no hurry. His home will be waiting whenever you are ready to finish unpacking.
lose.quote: So we beat on, boats against the current, borne back ceaselessly into the past.
lose.cite: F. Scott Fitzgerald, The Great Gatsby
